content: Build entry for make.fun news-image-20261118: Sum up 18 November 2026 world news in one image.
Analyzing competition data and top 15 entries...
Fetching competition API: 23,108 submissions, top score 978,389 (97.84%). Rules: PNG ≤1MiB, 1024x1024, deterministic.
Researching Nov 18 2026 events: Trump Manila ASEAN, Crimea Bridge, Gulf escalation, Cyclone Akvan, EU Budget, APEC Shenzhen.
Web search for 6 key topics across 4 regions completed. 7 major stories identified.
Designing front-page SVG layout with 4 regional panels, 7 stories. Generating 1024x1024 PNG via cairosvg.
PNG created: 1024x1024, 87726 bytes. Verified deterministic (2 runs byte-identical).
Setting up repo: entry.png, main.ts (copies image), package.json, LICENSE (MIT), .makefun/owner.json.
Testing entry: MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR=out node main.ts → deterministic output confirmed.
Creating GitHub repo zal-m10/news-image-20261118-entry, adding README with 3 required badges.
Pushed to GitHub, set homepage to make.fun bounty URL, added makefun topic.
Creating transcript session file for bundle submission with 11 assistant turns, usage data.
